question: Karnam Malleswari became the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal in which sporting discipline?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Weightlifting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Karnam Malleswari** became the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal by securing a bronze in Weightlifting at the **2000 Sydney Olympics**.
 
• She competed in the **69 kg Women’s Weightlifting category**, lifting a total of 240 kg (110 kg in snatch and 130 kg in clean and jerk).
